title: Finite Q3 energy-fourth coercive quotient for the Euclidean tail moment
question: Can the finite Q3 tail fourth moment be bounded by a positive shifted Hamiltonian fourth moment through an explicit generalized coercive quotient, while keeping its uniformity open?

mathematical_interface.positive_shift: For g>0 and r<0 use K_Lambda=I+H_Lambda+|Lambda| r^2/(4g) I; the declared Q3 onsite completion and positive bonds make K_Lambda positive on each finite matrix fixture.
mathematical_interface.generalized_quotient: For self-adjoint tail W define C_Lambda(W)=||K_Lambda^(-2) W^4 K_Lambda^(-2)||_infinity.
mathematical_interface.finite_operator_order: The positive congruence inequality gives W^4 <= C_Lambda(W) K_Lambda^4 in finite dimension.
mathematical_interface.gibbs_transfer: Therefore the Euclidean two-slice tail moment is at most Tr(rho W^4) <= C_Lambda(W) Tr(rho K_Lambda^4).
mathematical_interface.qft_role: This identifies the precise local energy-fourth-moment and quotient-uniformity obligations needed before the Holder corollary can enter a common-core Duhamel estimate.

lean_crosscheck.role: R349 checks scalar nonnegative envelope assembly only; matrix congruence, Q3 form positivity, Gibbs traces and all limiting statements remain Python evidence.

adversarial_review.check: The onsite completion uses |Lambda| r^2/(4g), derived from r q^2/2+g q^4/4+r^2/(4g)=g(q^2+r/g)^2/4; the extensive shift is not hidden.
The Q3 bond matrices are Hermitian on distinct tensor sites and their declared finite positivity is checked through the minimum eigenvalue of K rather than assumed from notation.
K^(-2)W^4K^(-2) is formed by positive shifted spectral inversion only; multiplying the positive quotient inequality by K^2 is kept as a finite congruence, not a commutation claim.
W is symmetrized before W^4 and the quotient are formed; no order statement is made for a non-self-adjoint tail.
The trace bound uses rho>=0 and the finite positive operator order; it does not replace Tr(rho K^4) by a volume-independent constant.
Only the positive energy shift K is inverted, never rho; the smallest K eigenvalue is reported and is not promoted to an infinite-volume domain bound.
The minimum eigenvalue slack of C K^4-W^4 is retained with a declared finite tolerance, including near-zero tails.
Both the generalized quotient C_Lambda(W) and Gibbs K^4 moment are summarized across beta, volume and cutoff; finite variation leaves uniformity open.
The calculation uses only the declared finite oscillator dimensions and does not establish a common unbounded Q3 form core.
The independent lane rebuilds Q3 matrices, shifted K, quotient and Gibbs traces without importing the primary script.
R349 certifies scalar envelope assembly only; the finite matrix order and QFT limits remain outside Lean.
This finite energy-moment bridge does not prove local common-core coercivity, direct Cauchy, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, common dynamics, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.
